title: Grilled Algerian Semolina Cakes
description: Delicious, crispy semolina cakes infused with aromatic spices, perfect as a snack or light meal. Serve warm with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine semolina, Algerian, flaky, and aromatic.
2. Gradually add water to the mixture, stirring until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
4. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
5. Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
6. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill over medium heat.
7. Brush the disks with a small amount of oil and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side.
9. Serve warm with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
